# Charlie Sloane & Gilbert Blythe

- [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) — Rival of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — rivals in the good graces of a certain damsel · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
- [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) — Friend of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — longtime friends · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P11](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0011)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk to school while discussing their classmates, including [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne.md) by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to recommend that she join an advanced class preparing for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Anne](../character/anne.md) is thrilled at the opportunity to study toward becoming a teacher and gladly accepts. After the class is organized, [Anne](../character/anne.md) navigates the dynamic of studying alongside her peers—including her rival, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)—while missing [Diana](../character/diana.md), who is not taking the exam.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on her silent academic rivalry and unspoken regret concerning [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exam. [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly packs away her books for a fun summer at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) visits [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and commends Anne's growth and character.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) suddenly dies from shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank failure, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) in deep grief. Neighbors come to offer support, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) gradually processes her loss through tears and conversation with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Later, as life begins to resume its normal routine, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) discussing future plans and Marilla's past relationship with John Blythe.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) attend a farewell party thrown by the A.V.I.S., where they receive gifts before [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) to spite [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). The next evening, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and takes her on a walk through the woods to find a wild apple tree, restoring her spirits ahead of her departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) bids a tearful farewell to her home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and leaves for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). After a rainy drive to the station and a boat ride from [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) travel by train to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). Upon arrival, [Anne](../character/anne.md) is warmly met by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who takes her by cab to their new boardinghouse while cheering her up.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), finding themselves drawn into social circles through their friendship with [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) earns distinction among the Freshmen after leading them to victory in the annual Arts Rush. Anne's homesickness is relieved when she receives a collection of letters from her friends and family back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) go for an afternoon walk with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) through the park and along the harbor shore. After watching the sunset from a pavilion, they walk back via [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) points out a charming, quaint house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a strong presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

> After finishing term examinations at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday where she is warmly greeted by [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and the twins. That night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps a troubled [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a dilemma about wanting to say a bad word so that he feels ready to say his prayers. During the break, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives letters from her friends, shares news with her family, and visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana.md) to air out the house and listen to the echoes once more.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her second term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while navigating romantic attentions from [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and unwanted proposals from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). Later, she and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) read a proposal from [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) to rent a house together for the next school year with Stella's [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as housekeeper. After searching unsuccessfully all spring, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) spot a 'To Let' sign on Patty's Place along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue).
>
> — v3 · Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place and decorate their new home. [Anne](../character/anne.md) reluctantly adopts a stray, disreputable cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), who miraculously survives a chloroforming attempt and earns a permanent spot in the house. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives with her own cats, adding to the household's lively atmosphere.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside on a June evening. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) complains about his schoolwork and the local funerals, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers to help him with his arithmetic. The conversation turns to local gossip, including Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and the town's reaction to [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejecting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling melancholic about Gilbert's absence and the changes that growing up brings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling a sense of disappointment and loneliness following her rejection of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She learns local gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), hears news of friends' engagements and marriages, visits Diana's new baby, and attends Phil's wedding.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings
